expectations.says: The infusion is written as three periods, one for each rate, and no period starts when the infusion is stopped.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS periods FROM omop.drug_exposure d JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = d.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990001231'

expectations.says: The three periods together run for 90 minutes, from fifteen minutes after the start of the anaesthetic to the stop of the infusion.
expectations.query: SELECT SUM(DATEDIFF(minute, d.drug_exposure_start_datetime, d.drug_exposure_end_datetime)) AS minutes, MIN(DATEDIFF(minute, vd.visit_detail_start_datetime, d.drug_exposure_start_datetime)) AS first_start FROM omop.drug_exposure d JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = d.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990001231'
